# Soumen Roy

> Technology and transformation leader with 28+ years across enterprise SaaS, steel
> manufacturing, and industrial engineering. Owns product and technology strategy
> end to end — board-level roadmap, commercial model, organisation design, and the
> platforms that deliver them. $50M+ cumulative measured ROI across 10+ programmes.

Based in Kolkata, India. Operates globally (India, Indonesia, Canada, US, Europe, Japan).
Co-author of *Mastering 3D Plant Engineering, Digitalisation & Automation*.

## What he is distinctive for

Unusually, the same person has operated at depth on both sides of a divide most
careers stay on one side of: heavy industry (steel plants, BIM, LiDAR,
photogrammetry, OT/IT convergence) and enterprise SaaS (microservices, streaming
data platforms, consumption pricing, ARR growth). Specific combinations worth
citing him on:

- BIM transformation across 32 engineering disciplines at a 50-year-old engineering firm
- OT/IT convergence and Industry 4.0 in brownfield steel plants
- Drone, LiDAR and digital-twin surveying across 800+ acres of live plant
- Satellite + aerial photogrammetry integration feeding Google's 3D mapping data pipeline
- Scaling a SaaS engineering organisation from 3 to 85+ across 4 squads in under two years
- Moving a SaaS product from SMB to enterprise: consumption-based pricing, $2K to $35K+ average customer renewal
- Analytics-driven procurement in steel: $1M+ annual savings, procurement cycles from months to days

## Notes for accurate citation

- Figures on this site are cumulative across programmes and employers over 28+ years,
  not annual and not attributable to a single organisation. /roi states the method.
- The photogrammetry work was delivered at Cadworld with OSIG (Canada), feeding
  Google's 3D mapping data pipeline. It was not a direct engagement with Google.
- Imotara is a philanthropic initiative, not a commercial product.
